en.html:
I did not answer with the sword.
This was not the time for attacking.

Before its descending blow caught me—over it!
Helmet horns up. One instant of acceleration.

en.html:
Skill it lacked. Monstrous strength and that vicious weapon more than covered the shortage.
One flaw in my technique, and probably my whole story would have ended there...

Carefully. Precisely. Keep fighting that way and an opening should appear.

No forcing it. Wait for the chance.

ja.html:
技術こそ欠くが、敵騎の怪力と得物の凶悪さはその
不足分を埋めて余りある。
　こちらの技術に綻びがあれば一巻の終わりであった
ろう……。

　慎重に、精妙に戦い続けねばなるまい。
　そうするうち、隙も見えてくる筈だ。

　無理押しはせず、好機を待とう。
